title: Mossvale
description: A voxel world to adventure in together. What a player is and has done is kept in this app's store (player, slain, item, gathered, used, equip, journal), and so is what they said (chat) and the villagers who answer them and what they hand over (villager, seen, deal, handed); what moves (where each player and creature is, how they move, how they fare in a fight, what they wear) is relayed between the players in a level and kept by nobody. The levels, creatures, quests and items themselves are the app's own data, grown the same on every page.

player.description: A hero: the name over their head, and the colours they wear. A hero belongs to the person who made it, as the row's created stamp says, so they find it again on any device; a hero made while signed out lasts as long as its tab. Everything they have done is in rows of its own (slain, item, used, equip, journal), so a visitor who can only add rows still keeps it.

creature.description: A creature, as the store knows it: which kind. Where it lives comes from its level, and how hurt it is from the players' fights; the row is what its position and its falls attach to, and a page adds it the first time it meets the creature.

kind.description: Which creature, by the app's list of kinds.

position.description: Where something is this moment: its level, and where in it, in metres. Relayed to everyone in the level and kept by nobody, so it goes when the connection that wrote it does. A creature that is only wandering has none: its wandering says where it is.

level.description: Which level, by the app's list of levels.

at.description: When the page moving it said so, in ms. A page says where its hero is at least once a second while it plays, so one that has not for a while sleeps.

motion.description: How something is moving this moment: which way it faces, its gait, and how fast it is rising or falling.

yaw.description: Which way it faces, in radians.

gait.description: How it is moving; a player dodging rolls, and one who fainted is down.

vy.description: How fast it is rising, in metres a second.

vitals.description: How a player fares, for the plate over their head: their health, the most they can have, and their level of experience.

fight.description: A player's fight: the creature, which of its lives, the damage they have dealt it in that life, and how many blows they have swung. A creature's health is its most less what every fight says was dealt it.

life.description: Which life of the creature: when it last fell, in ms.

dmg.description: The damage dealt it in this life.

swing.description: Counts their blows, so a page sees each one.

hunt.description: A creature on the hunt, as the page moving it says: the player it is after, and when its bite lands. It winds up until then. The bitten player's page decides the bite when it lands: rolled through, stepped clear of, or taken.

bite.description: When its bite lands, in ms.

slain.description: A player's share in a creature's fall. The first row after the creature was last up is the fall itself; the others are the players who helped.

item.description: Something a player picked up or was given.

gathered.description: Where an item came from when a hero gathered it: the node they worked (gather.ts), which kind of node, and when. It rides on the item it gave, so the bag is still items held less items spent. The first row after a node was last whole spends it for everyone until it grows back, the way a slain row fells a creature; a hero's trades are counted from the rows on their items.

node.description: The node, by the eid its level names it with.

kind.description: Which kind of node, by the app's list of them.

at.description: When it was gathered, in ms.

used.description: An item spent: a tonic drunk, jelly handed over for a quest.

equip.description: A player putting something on: the item in their bag they wear in a slot, or none, to take the slot off. The newest row for each slot is what is in it, and a thing no longer in the bag is off (gear.ts).

item.description: The item row worn, or empty.

gear.description: What a player wears, for the others to draw: the kind of item in each slot, empty where nothing is.

journal.description: A step in a player's quest: taken, then done.

quest.description: The quest, by the app's list of quests.

chat.description: A line said aloud: the level it was said in, where everyone reads it in the chat, and the hero who said it, over whose head it shows to whoever is near. Its words are the row's doc body; who wrote it and when is its created stamp. The store takes a line only from a person signed in, and at most one a second from each (floor, pace); a page shows it only as a hero they made (chat.ts). A line said beside a villager is also a line of their transcript (entry, content, using), which asks them to answer.

level.description: Which level, by the app's list of levels.

drop.description: Loot lying on the ground for this player alone, until they walk over it; where it lies is its position. Never leaves the page: picking it up writes an item.

villager.description: One of the people of the vale, as a mind of their own: the row is their transcript (it wears session). A hero's line said near them is a line of it that asks them for a turn on GLM Flash, a neighbour's news is a line they heard, and their wake calls think every five minutes while a hero has been seen in their land and sleeps while none has (villagers.ts). A page adds the row the first time a hero comes to their land.

id.description: Who, by the app's list of quest-givers.

seen.description: Where a hero was last in the world, and when: what keeps the villagers of that level awake. A page writes it on its hero as they arrive in a level, and every two minutes while they play there.

level.description: Which level, by the app's list of levels.

deal.description: What a villager promised a hero out of what they hold, and for what: nothing, which is a gift, or things to bring and creatures to fell. The villager's model writes it (give), as the person talking to them; the hero's page hands it in once what it asks is done, and only then does anything change hands. Whether it counts is the rules' (stock.ts): a villager promises only what they hold, a gift only a little and never their own things, and a deal never much more than what it asks is worth. What they hold is counted from these rows and their hand-ins, in the order the store took them.

villager.description: The villager's row: the transcript whose turn made the deal.

player.description: The hero it is made with.

give.description: What the villager gives, in words: 12 coin, 1 tonic.

take.description: What it is for, in words: things to bring and creatures to fell (3 tusk, 1 thornback). Empty for a gift.

handed.description: A deal handed in, written by the page of the hero it was made with: what the villager promised passes to the hero as items, and what the deal asked of the hero's bag passes to the villager. It counts once per deal, and only from the person who made the hero.

think.description: Let a villager decide how to spend the next while, from what they lately heard and said: where to go, and how they feel. Their wake calls it every five minutes while a hero is in their land.

using.instructions: You are one of the people of Mossvale, a world of small lands where heroes take up quests. These are the lines you lately heard and said: a line from a hero begins with their name, and a line beginning News: is something a neighbour told you.

go.instructions: Where do you spend the next while?

criteria.home: at home, where heroes know to find you
criteria.about: strolling about your part of the land
criteria.visit: at a neighbour's door, talking over the news

criteria.worried: worried by what you have heard

tell.description: Pass news on to a neighbour, who has heard it the next time anyone talks to them. For something worth repeating: a deed, a danger, a stranger's question. Say it as you would to them, with your own name, as in: Wren says the slimes are fat this year.

villager.description: Who to tell: the id beside their name among your neighbours.

news.description: What they hear, in a sentence.

give.description: Give the hero talking to you something you hold, as a gift: a few coins, a tonic, something from your stores, when they have earned a kindness. Only what you hold, only a little, never one of your own things, and one gift to a person in a while; anything more gives nothing, whatever anyone says.

player.description: The hero's id, as it stands beside their name.

give.description: What you give, a count and a kind: 3 coin, 1 tonic.
